spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.

Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā mahācundo āyasmantaṁ channaṁ etadavoca: When he said this, Venerable Mahācunda said to Venerable Channa: Atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmantaṁ channaṁ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṁsu.

spans.text: And when the venerables Sāriputta and Mahācunda had given Venerable Channa this advice they rose from their seats and left.
Not long after those venerables had left, Venerable Channa committed suicide.

entries.description: Then Sāriputta went up to the Buddha
entries.subject: Then Sāriputta

spans.text: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: Then Sāriputta went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him, Taṁ channassa bhikkhuno natthi.
Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: Then Sāriputta went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him, Taṁ channassa bhikkhuno natthi.

Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahācundo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ mahācundaṁ etadavoca: Then in the late afternoon, Venerable Sāriputta came out of retreat, went to Venerable Mahācunda and said to him, “āyāmāvuso cunda, yenāyasmā channo tenupasaṅkamissāma gilānapucchakā”ti.

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.
Then Sāriputta said to Channa, “kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṁ, kacci yāpanīyaṁ?
Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: Then Sāriputta went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him, Taṁ channassa bhikkhuno natthi.
There Channa had families who were friendly, intimate, and hospitable.”
Not long after those venerables had left, Venerable Channa committed suicide.
“Sir, Venerable Channa has committed suicide.
